name: Crash Recovery and Abandoned Session Reconciliation
description: On crash or unexpected termination, detect abandoned sessions, reconcile state from durable stores, and offer recovery paths.
purpose: Crashes should never corrupt state or strand work.
acceptanceCriteria: On startup, scanner detects sessions with no active heartbeat
Abandoned sessions are flagged and offered for recovery or cleanup
Recovery replays session journal from last checkpoint to reconstruct state
Recovery is user-confirmed before mutating any durable state
Cleanup of abandoned sessions releases all claimed resources (locks, ports, file handles)
Recovery logs are written for post-mortem analysis
required_evidence: Abandoned session detection on startup test
User confirmation gate test (recovery does not proceed without consent)
Cleanup releases all claimed resources test
acceptance_gates: Startup scanner detects sessions with no heartbeat
Recovery replays journal from last checkpoint
rollback_strategy: Recovery that fails mid-step rolls back partial state restoration via resource teardown
recovery_strategy: Recovery is itself the recovery strategy — journal replay from last checkpoint
escalation_policy: If recovery fails after max attempts, flag session for manual forensics and alert user
